run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T16:00:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on frontend-proxy is explained by an outage of the checkout workload in namespace otel-demo. At 16:00:23–16:00:33 the checkout Deployment rolled out a new ReplicaSet (checkout-d75b77f99) whose container image is 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' — an invalid reference containing a newline. The only checkout pod, checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, has been Pending since 16:00:33 with container waiting reason InvalidImageName ('couldn't parse image name ... invalid reference format'); the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (correct image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled 1→0 at 16:00:26. The Deployment now has 0 ready/available replicas, 1 unavailable, and the checkout Service has only a not-ready endpoint, so nothing serves checkout traffic. Correspondingly, frontend's gRPC calls to oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder went from 0 errors to all-error samples (UNSET rate 0, ERROR rate 0.60–0.71 spans/s from 16:05:16 to 16:11:16), frontend tcp.connect spans became 100% errors from 16:03:16, and frontend POST /api/checkout, POST and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' recorded 361.3 ERROR spans over the window. frontend-proxy's ingress (server) and 'router frontend egress' (client) spans carry 373.6 and 364.4 ERROR spans; 5.86% of ingress spans were ERROR at 16:13:16 versus a near-zero pre-incident baseline. The deep cause is the checkout Deployment's invalid image, not frontend-proxy, frontend, node pressure or the unrelated flagd EventStream errors seen on ad/fraud-detection/recommendation.

claims.text: frontend-proxy traces_span_metrics_calls_total has STATUS_CODE_ERROR only for span_name 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; ingress ERROR rate was ~0 until 16:00, rose to 0.60–0.76 spans/s between 16:05:16 and 16:10:16, and was 0.217 spans/s at the last returned sample 16:14:16 (baseline 0–0.004 spans/s earlier in the window).
At 16:13:16, 5.86% of frontend-proxy ingress spans (status ERROR / all ingress statuses over 5m) were errors.

ERROR-status span increases over the whole window are concentrated on the checkout path: frontend-proxy 'ingress' 373.55 and 'router frontend egress' 364.39; frontend 'POST' 361.34, 'POST /api/checkout' 361.23, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 361.34, 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 361.34, 'tcp.connect' 19.34.

frontend's client span 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' shows the transition: UNSET rate 0.13–0.71 spans/s before 16:03, then ERROR 0.256->0.60->0.631->0.715 spans/s while UNSET dropped to 0 at/after 16:07:16 (i.e. all observed PlaceOrder calls in those samples failed).

frontend span 'tcp.connect' had STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate 0 for the entire window and ERROR first appeared at 16:03:16 (0.048 spans/s, peak 0.0556, last 0.008 at 16:13:16), i.e. connect attempts started failing when the checkout rollout happened.

The checkout service's own spans carry no ERROR status at all over the window (e.g. 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 786.80 and 'HTTP POST' 2360.41, all STATUS_CODE_UNSET), so the failures are not recorded inside checkout itself.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout is at generation 4 with pod-template image 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0', readyReplicas and availableReplicas null, unavailableReplicas 1, and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 16:00:33.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99) is Pending since 16:00:33; its checkout container is not ready with state waiting reason InvalidImageName, message 'Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format'.

Events in otel-demo show the rollout and its failure: Deployment checkout 'Scaled up replica set checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1' (first 16:00:23, last 16:00:33) and 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0' at 16:00:26; pods checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx and checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 emitted InspectFailed (counts 2 and 27) and Failed 'Error: InvalidImageName' (counts 2 and 12) between 16:00:25 and 16:05:47.

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 15:22:18, owned by Deployment checkout) uses the previous good image 'ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout' and is at replicas 0; ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (created 16:00:23) uses 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' at replicas 1.
The checkout Service's Endpoints object holds no ready addresses; its only subset contains notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.211 referring to pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68.

checkout is the only otel-demo Deployment with unavailable replicas or a non-ghcr.io image; the other 20 Deployments (accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) report ready=1/available=1 with ghcr.io or vendor images, and frontend-proxy itself is generation 1, ready 1, available 1.

Before the incident the checkout path worked: a stored trace slice from 15:48:18 shows frontend spans 'POST' -> 'POST /api/checkout' -> 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' -> 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (parent references present) with http.status_code 200 and rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

flagd streaming errors are not the cause of this alert: ERROR increases on 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (ad 3.05) and '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (fraud-detection 1.03, recommendation 3.05) belong to those services' flagd spans, not to frontend-proxy, and no returned evidence ties them to the ingress/checkout path.

frontend-proxy is not the origin: its Deployment is unchanged (generation 1, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend-proxy, 1 ready/1 available) and its error spans are limited to ingress/egress operations whose rise coincides with the checkout rollout, not with any frontend-proxy object change.

Node/scheduler resource shortage is not the cause: pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 reports PodScheduled=True and its init container wait-for-kafka ran after 'Successfully pulled image busybox:latest', so the pod was scheduled and the node could pull images; the blocking reason is the unparsable main container image name.

Causal mechanism: because the checkout Service has no ready endpoints, frontend's gRPC PlaceOrder calls and new TCP connections fail (all observed tcp.connect spans error from 16:03:16, all observed PlaceOrder spans error from ~16:07:16), the frontend /api/checkout route therefore errors, and frontend-proxy records the failed requests as ingress ERROR spans plus 'router frontend egress' ERROR spans; the checkout process itself never receives the requests, which is why checkout emitted no ERROR spans.

The frontend-proxy -> frontend call edge is inferred only from the operation names 'ingress' (server) and 'router frontend egress' (client) plus coincident error timing; no post-16:00 trace with parent references was available to prove the proxy-to-frontend span relationship.

Restore the checkout Deployment to a valid image — roll back to the previous ReplicaSet's image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout (or correct the string so it contains no newline/whitespace), then confirm the new pod reaches Ready, the Deployment reports available replicas and the checkout Endpoints gain a ready address, which should end the frontend /api/checkout failures and the frontend-proxy ingress errors.

Trace how Deployment checkout reached generation 4 (Helm release otel-demo) and consider admission-time validation of container image references so an unparsable image name cannot roll a single-replica service to zero ready pods.

gaps: Jaeger returned no traces for the 15:50–16:21 windows (frontend-proxy search 15:50–16:21 and frontend search 16:01–16:15 both returned no data; the frontend sample contains only spans at ~15:48), so HTTP/gRPC status codes and parent references for the failing requests after 16:00 were not observed.

Application logs could not be used: fetch_pod_logs returned 0 lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 (15:55–16:15) and for checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (init and app containers, no previous instance), so error text tying the failures together comes from metrics, spans and Kubernetes objects only.
list_prometheus_rules returned no rules (no_data) for name RequestErrorRate and for all alerting rules, so the alert's own PromQL expression and threshold could not be verified.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what applied the checkout Deployment's invalid image (generation 4) at ~16:00:23 is unknown.
Metric data ends around 16:13:16–16:14:16, so the state after that instant (including whether the alert is still firing) is unknown.

A small frontend-proxy ingress ERROR blip occurred at 15:49:16–15:54:16 (0.0074–0.0185 spans/s) before the checkout rollout; its cause is not explained by the evidence and it is not tied to this alert.

Traffic to cart, currency, product-catalog, payment, shipping and email shows no error evidence in the returned ERROR series (payment's GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect ERROR series are 0), but for services with no ERROR series returned their error state is unknown rather than proven zero.
next_steps: Human review of the checkout Deployment rollout: confirm the intended image value and re-apply a valid image, then verify pod readiness and Service endpoints.
Check the pipeline/GitOps source (change_history is not integrated here) for the change that set the image to a value containing a newline.
After remediation, re-check frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and frontend-proxy 'ingress' ERROR rates to confirm they return to the pre-16:00 baseline.
